source: Vegetable Market Price, Koyambedu history API; attributed to Koyambedu Vegetable Merchants Council; https://vegetablemarketprice.com/market/koyambedu/history
monsoon_note: Rainfall anomaly is standardized against the same calendar month within the local weather file, not a long-run climatology. HAC regression uses seven-day price return and controls for prior seven-day price momentum; market arrival volume is absent. The short local weather record (two complete Northeast Monsoon seasons) means p-values are exploratory and do not fulfill the proposal’s claim of a statistically established monsoon effect.
procurement_note: A rule-based 14-day XGBoost counterfactual was run on the local Tomato candidate series. It assumes a normalized one-quote-unit purchase, compares the advice timing with buying entirely at the origin, and omits storage, transport, spoilage, quality, stockouts and inventory constraints. The observations are attributed to the Koyambedu Vegetable Merchants' Council. The API unit is 1kg; this analysis does not independently establish wholesale transaction basis or realized economic value/savings.
benchmark_note: Published Koyambedu SARIMA study reports monthly series/horizon metrics; those are not directly comparable with these daily 7/14/30-day matched-origin scores. No numeric cross-study delta is claimed.
